Faculty Review
Faculty Initial: Amtr
Amreen Talukdar
Course: MGT368
She will take 2 quizzes, 2 group case studies, and will count the best 1. 1 solo case on a local entrepreneur business, 1mid exam& final. And obviously, a Business plan (group of 5-7, depending on the number of students in that section) & group presentation.
If you attend her classes regularly and remain attentive, you won't face any problems in the exams. Her quizzes are very easy, and all content will come from the slides.
In the midterm and final exams, there will be two sections: MCQ and SAQ. All questions will be based on the slides and class lectures.
There are two types of SAQs: some will be straightforward questions taken directly from the slides, while others will require analytical responses. For example, you might be asked, "As an entrepreneur, what would you do?" or "What would you suggest?"
In the midterm and final exams, Miss expects direct answers; she doesn't like lengthy answers, and there will be a page limit. The same applies to group case studies; your answers should be on point.
For solo case studies, you've to take an interview with an entrepreneur who is running their business and has a trade licence. The assignment should look like a storytelling of the entrepreneur's journey, how they started the business, and how they are currently running it.
Group project / Business plan will contain 20% marks and 5% in your group presentation. So, you must put effort into that. Be innovative, creative, and realistic. You have to convince her that this business can actually work and that you can make profits in the future.
Try to bring your product samples on your presentation day, or any poster, flyer, or anything, for example: you can build a website or blueprints of your service/ product. She really appreciates your hard work.
Also, for the class participation mark, you must ask questions to other groups after their presentation.
Her grading will be fair, but I think she might curve if you are missing 0.5-1 mark. Overall, she is very nice, teaches effectively, and makes the material easy to understand.
To achieve your desired grades, you need to put effort into the solo case and the group project, as they will contain 35% of the total marks. The exams are relatively easy—just follow the lectures and the slides, and that should be sufficient to earn good marks.
Best of Luck.
